roster_eligibility.batting: official game-linked confirmed lineup ordered slots 1..9, matching teams and game; actual starting lineup record is allowed with explicit source semantics
not_allowed: first nine postgame batters assumed starters
batting order number alone assumed starter
schedule probable pitcher alone assumed actual starter
roster_eligibility.starter: official actual pitching record with explicit start flag or verified presentation order/starting field; crosscheck schedule ID/name and record mismatches
roster_eligibility.player_identity: unique official identity linkage for the official starting names; same-game official record/profile identity-only linkage is allowed in retrospective tier; no target performance values in features
roster_eligibility.announcement_vs_actual: keep distinct if changed; actual-used roster is primary retrospective target; exact historical preannouncement receipt is not claimed
roster_eligibility.duplicates_or_ambiguous_identity: exclude with reason, no guessed/fuzzy ID or zero substitute

input_construction.paired_training: same eligible fixture IDs for projected and actual rosters; never compare reduced actual training volume to full projected and attribute all change to rosters
input_construction.player_histories: identical canonical past raw and official supplement for both, target and same-calendar-day performance excluded, last ten complete component observations; observed zero retained, missing not zero
input_construction.keep_base_features: team/rest/park fields unchanged per fixture in both schemes
input_construction.role_vocabulary: fit partition only; unknown identity neutral role effect with preserved separate directional and symmetric quality flags
input_construction.pit_proof: actual roster recovery is retrospective fact linkage, not proof of historical received-at
input_construction.pitcher_bf: do not use as batters-faced; ERA ER/outs definition fixed
input_construction.no_new_model_features: only roster selectors and corresponding past player history change; no new ratios, time-decay, thresholds or stacking

model_families.M0: preceding aggregate independent Poisson, base L2=10 fixed
model_families.M2: preceding corrected v2 multinomial with 12 symmetric missingness/unknown counts; base L2=10 and player L2=100 fixed

primary_design.development_evaluation: 2025 eligible paired cases, report actual and projected input scenarios
primary_design.final_primary_test: 2026 verified actual lineup/starter common subset of preceding709 target fixtures
primary_design.final_secondary_test: projected selectors on same final target subset
primary_design.if_actual_starter_verification_reduces_t: all models and price ledgers use same reduced subset; disclose denominator/exclusions and do not reuse full709 numbers as new result
primary_design.old_full_training_models: replay frozen M0 and corrected M2 on identical new test inputs as contextual references; old full training sizes differ and are not a roster-only causal contrast
primary_design.minimum_fit_gate: at least100 training cases across2teams and all required outcomes; otherwise finite blocked_data with source counts, not fabricated performance
primary_design.prediction_freeze: commit selected settings/input hashes/models/predictions before final label settlement
primary_design.all_years_previously_seen: retrospective reused diagnostics only, not blind holdout

settlement.prices: reuse same frozen original strict and extended ledgers, same product/full-game two-way, draw refunds count in stake denominator
settlement.current_buyReject_sensitivity: same seven nonzero current reject originals excluded for all models as sensitivity, not historical sellability proof
settlement.stake: flat1unit per fixture, no actual wagering, no monthly wallet replay

metrics: conditional home-away accuracy/log loss/Brier on decisive outcomes
mean predicted draw and observed draw rate
paired calendar-week95% intervals and pick changes
known/unknown roster coverage by training scheme and season
matched training/test counts and complete exclusion reasons
required_tests: official roster/actual starter evidence and unique IDs
raw and Git blob source hashes and both autocrlf byte checks
names/ID identity linkage separated from target statistics
no zero filling or fake BF denominator
M0/M2 refit and prediction independent replay
